mapper.select: SELECT R.RESULT_NO, R.SCHEDULE_NO, R.PROCESS_DATE, R.PROCESS_CONTENT, R.RESULT_STATUS, R.IMAGE_PATH, R.IMAGE_PATH2, R.CREATED_AT, E.ENGINEER_NAME FROM AS_RESULT R LEFT JOIN AS_SCHEDULE S ON R.SCHEDULE_NO = S.SCHEDULE_NO LEFT JOIN ENGINEER E ON S.ENGINEER_NO = E.ENGINEER_NO

SELECT R.RESULT_NO AS resultNo, R.SCHEDULE_NO AS scheduleNo, R.PROCESS_DATE AS processDate, R.PROCESS_CONTENT AS processContent, R.IMAGE_PATH AS imagePath, R.IMAGE_PATH2 AS imagePath2, R.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, E.ENGINEER_NAME AS engineerName FROM AS_RESULT R LEFT JOIN AS_SCHEDULE S ON R.SCHEDULE_NO = S.SCHEDULE_NO LEFT JOIN ENGINEER E ON S.ENGINEER_NO = E.ENGINEER_NO ORDER BY R.PROCESS_DATE DESC
